camel_example: aliyun aideepsign CreateC2paSignTask --region cn-hangzhou --SoftwareAgent 'Alibaba Cloud Qwen ImageGen' --FileUrl 'https://example.com/images/photo.png?token=xxx' --BucketRegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --BucketName 'example-bucket' --SourceType trainedAlgorithmicMedia --ObjectKey 'ai-deepsign/example.png' --CustomAssertions '[{"label":"com.example.internal","data":{"meta_id":"emp001","generation":{"modelVersion":"2.1","count":3},"tags":["AI生成","电商"],"enabled":true,"optional":null}}]' --TargetObjectKey 'ai-deepsign-signed/2026/photo.png' --AllowOverwrite false --TargetBucketName 'example-target-bucket' --TargetBucketRegion 'cn-shanghai' --version 2026-05-11 --method POST --force
description_en: Creates a C2PA content credential signing task for a specified file and returns the task ID
description_zh: 为指定文件创建C2PA内容凭证签名任务并返回任务ID
kebab_example: aliyun aideepsign create-c-2-pa-sign-task --file-url 'https://example.com/images/photo.png?token=xxx' --source-type trainedAlgorithmicMedia --software-agent 'Alibaba Cloud Qwen ImageGen' --custom-assertions '[{"label":"com.example.internal","data":{"meta_id":"emp001","generation":{"modelVersion":"2.1","count":3},"tags":["AI生成","电商"],"enabled":true,"optional":null}}]' --bucket-region-id cn-hangzhou --bucket-name example-bucket --object-key ai-deepsign/example.png --target-bucket-name example-target-bucket --target-object-key ai-deepsign-signed/2026/photo.png --allow-overwrite false --target-bucket-region cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateC2paSignTask

parameters.help_en: The absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL of signature file to be signed. The URL can be up to 4,096 characters in length and cannot contain URL user info. The URL path must end with a .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .mp4, .flac, .m4a, .mp3, or .wav file name. Signature file name extension is case-insensitive. The URL query is not used for file name identification. The source URL must be accessible by the service and directly return an HTTP 200 status code. Redirection is not supported. The size of a single file cannot exceed 800 MiB
parameters.help_zh: 待签名文件的绝对 HTTP 或 HTTPS 地址，最多 4096 个字符，不能包含 URL user info。URL path 须以 `.jpg`、`.jpeg`、`.png`、`.mp4`、`.flac`、`.m4a`、`.mp3` 或 `.wav` 文件名结尾，扩展名大小写不敏感；URL query 不参与文件名识别。源地址必须可由服务访问并直接返回 HTTP 200，不支持重定向。单个文件大小不得超过 800 MiB
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.help_en: The optional content source type. The value can be up to 128 characters in length. It supports 19 short names and their corresponding full HTTP URIs, and is case-sensitive. Examples include digitalCapture and trainedAlgorithmicMedia. The source declaration is written into the content credentials of the signed file. If this parameter is not specified, no additional source type is declared. The service will deny invalid values during the creation phase. For the complete enumeration and URIs, see the supplementary description of request parameters
parameters.help_zh: 可选的内容来源类型，最多 128 个字符。支持 19 个短名称及其对应的完整 HTTP URI，区分大小写；例如 `digitalCapture`、`trainedAlgorithmicMedia`。来源声明会写入签名文件的内容凭证；未填写则不额外声明，非法值在创建阶段拒绝。完整枚举和 URI 见请求参数补充说明
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The optional name of the software that generated or processed the content. The value can be up to 128 characters in length, such as Example Studio 1.0. This software information is written into the content credentials of the signed file and is independent of SourceType and CustomAssertions
parameters.help_zh: 可选的生成或处理内容的软件名称，最多 128 个字符，例如 `Example Studio 1.0`。该软件信息会写入签名文件的内容凭证，与 `SourceType` 和 `CustomAssertions` 独立
parameters.name: software_agent

parameters.help_en: The optional list of custom assertions. Pass a JSON array string. The original JSON text can be up to 4,096 UTF-8 bytes in length and contain up to 64 assertions. Each item must and can only contain label and data. data supports any JSON value. Objects and arrays can be nested up to 5 levels deep. JSON integers must be within the signed 64-bit range. The assertions are written into the manifest of the signed file and can be read and authenticated for integrity by label. For detailed formats, limits, and examples, see the supplementary description of request parameters
parameters.help_zh: 可选的自定义声明列表，请传入 JSON 数组字符串。原始 JSON 文本最多 4096 个 UTF-8 字节、最多 64 条声明；每项必须且只能包含 `label` 和 `data`。`data` 支持任意 JSON 值，对象和数组最多嵌套 5 层，JSON 整数须在有符号 64 位范围内。声明将写入本次签名文件的 Manifest，可按 `label` 读取并验证完整性。详细格式、限制及示例见请求参数补充说明
parameters.name: custom_assertions

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the user's OSS bucket where the source file is located. This parameter, together with BucketName and ObjectKey, forms the bucket source. You must specify either this parameter or FileUrl. Example: cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 源文件所在用户OSS Bucket的地域ID，与BucketName、ObjectKey共同构成Bucket源，与FileUrl二选一必填，如cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: bucket_region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the user's OSS bucket where the source file is located. This parameter, together with BucketRegionId and ObjectKey, forms the bucket source. You must specify either this parameter or FileUrl
parameters.help_zh: 源文件所在用户OSS Bucket名称，与BucketRegionId、ObjectKey共同构成Bucket源，与FileUrl二选一必填
parameters.name: bucket_name

parameters.help_en: The object key of the source file in the user's OSS bucket. This parameter, together with BucketRegionId and BucketName, forms the bucket source. You must specify either this parameter or FileUrl
parameters.help_zh: 源文件在用户OSS Bucket中的Object Key，与BucketRegionId、BucketName共同构成Bucket源，与FileUrl二选一必填
parameters.name: object_key

parameters.help_en: The optional name of the user's OSS bucket to which the signing result is written. If this parameter is left empty, the result is written to an internal bucket of the service and returned through SignedFileUrl
parameters.help_zh: 可选，签名结果写入的用户OSS Bucket名称；为空时结果写入服务内部Bucket并通过SignedFileUrl返回
parameters.name: target_bucket_name

parameters.help_en: The optional full object key of the signing artifact written to the user's bucket. This parameter must be provided together with TargetBucketName. It must start with ai-deepsign-signed/ and be a full object name with an extension, not a directory prefix. The server does not append the _signed suffix or a trailing slash
parameters.help_zh: 可选，签名产物写入用户Bucket的完整Object Key，须与TargetBucketName同时提供；必须以ai-deepsign-signed/开头，且为含扩展名的完整对象名（非目录前缀），服务端不再追加_signed后缀或补尾斜杠
parameters.name: target_object_key

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to allow overwriting when the destination object already exists. The default value is false, which means that creation is rejected if the destination object already exists. If you set this parameter to true, existing objects can be overwritten, which supports in-place signing where the destination object key can be the same as the source object key
parameters.help_zh: 可选，目标对象已存在时是否允许覆盖，缺省false即目标已存在则拒绝创建；置true允许覆盖既有对象，支持就地签名（目标Object Key可与源相同）
parameters.name: allow_overwrite

parameters.help_en: The optional region ID of the destination user's OSS bucket to which the signing result is written. If this parameter is left empty, the source BucketRegionId is reused for same-region writes. You must explicitly specify this parameter for cross-region writes
parameters.help_zh: 可选，签名结果写入的目标用户OSS Bucket所在地域ID；为空时复用源BucketRegionId（同地域写入），跨地域写入时须显式指定
parameters.name: target_bucket_region

TaskId.title_zh: 官方C2PA单文件签名任务ID，可用于GetC2paSignResult查询
